object.name: evi.ladder.transistor~
object.digest: Nonlinear TPT Transistor Ladder filter emulation
object.description: A dirty nonlinear 24dB Transistor Ladder filter emulation. The object provides two FM modulation inlets for the filter cutoff frequency. This filter has been tuned to be quite 'hot' and aggressive compared to the <o>evi.ladder.moog~</o> object, which may be preferable if a cleaner sound is required.
object.discussion: Based on the famous original by Teemu Voipio, Copyright 2012 Teemu Voipio. See the .gendsp source code for the license. For more information about other nonlinear Ladder filters in evieve, see the 'evieve ladder' tab of the helpfile.

inlets.description: Cutoff frequency in Pitch or Hz (default) depending on the @cutoffmode attribute.
Logarithmic FM input. Accepts an FM signal which is summed internally with cutoff in pitch prior to Linear FM inlet. This is only active if @cutoffmode attribute == 1, otherwise it is ignored.
Linear FM input. Accepts an FM signal which is summed internally with cutoff in Hz post Logarithmic FM input. This inlet is always active regardless of the @cutoffmode attribute.
Self oscillates at resonance > 0.9 but can take values > 1. High resonance values still work but lose a little tuning accuracy above about 2kHz cutoff.

attributes.name: cutoffmode
attributes.description: Switch cutoff frequency (inlet 2) between Pitch (on) or Hz (default off).

attributes.name: cutoffsmooth
attributes.description: Optionally smooth the cutoff (inlet 2). If audio rate modulating inlet 2 (or potentially with inlets 3 or 4) this should be turned off.

attributes.name: oversample
attributes.description: 2x oversampling if on (default), 1x if off (careful). Oversampling almost doubles the CPU usage.

attributes.name: ressmooth
attributes.description: Optionally smooth the resonance (inlet 5). If audio rate modulating inlet 5 this should be turned off.
